verdict.rationale: Flagright documents a rule engine with nested no-code logic and a Management API for creating and updating rule instances, which act as live entities that check every incoming transaction. Rule execution results, alerts and alert hits are documented, and webhooks push real-time event notifications, so rules defined by the user run automatically on transaction events. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of which actions a rule hit triggers (e.g., blocking a transaction or auto-creating a case), detail on how the Workflow Builder ties into rule outcomes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
